aboutPage.title: About Wolfyslayer Records
aboutPage.intro: Independent curation for two distinct artists under one roof.
aboutPage.relationshipBody: Wolfyslayer Records is the independent label that releases and presents music from Frostmark and Wolfyslayer. Frostmark and Wolfyslayer are separate artist projects with their own music and identities; the label provides shared infrastructure — this website, release planning, and press materials — without blending those identities into one act.
